title: 4D Chicago Scene
description: A scene names a date and a terrain epoch. Everything else in the dataset resolves against it. Adding a year is a new scene file, not a restructure.

target_date.description: The single date this scene depicts. Enforced against every structure phase.

terrain_epoch.description: Must resolve in data/terrain/epochs.json, and its interval must cover target_date.

lighting.description: A specific, documented moment — not a vibe. Sun azimuth and elevation are computed from this plus the datum lat/lon.

anchors.description: Named viewpoints. The smoke harness reads the same anchors the walkthrough uses, so screenshots and gameplay can never diverge.

altitude_m.description: Metres above local ground. Present = this is an AERIAL viewpoint: arriving at it puts the visitor in free-fly at this height rather than on foot. Absent = a standing viewpoint, which is the historical default and stays so.

pitch_deg.description: Look angle, negative is downward. Only meaningful alongside altitude_m — a standing viewpoint looks at the horizon.

released.description: Cannot be true while any included structure carries review_required.
